name: lib_expanding_iterate_dist_le
statement: {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ dist (f x) (f y)) (k : ℕ) (x y : X) : dist x y ≤ dist (f^[k] x) (f^[k] y)
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ dist (f x) (f y)) (k : ℕ) (x y : X), dist x y ≤ dist (f^[k] x) (f^[k] y)
informal: Iterates of a distance non-decreasing (expanding) self-map of a pseudometric space are again expanding: dist x y ≤ dist (f^[k] x) (f^[k] y). Promoted from Mathlib2.top_expanding_compact_isometry_aux1 (the isometry analogue is re-derived in top_isometry_compact_surjective); generalised from metric to pseudometric spaces.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : PseudoMetricSpace X] (f : X → X), (∀ (x y : X), dist x y ≤ dist (f x) (f y)) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (x y : X), dist x y ≤ dist (f^[k] x) (f^[k] y)
